data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'Mary' and 'linos' meaning 'shining, radiant'. This name symbolizes the star that shone over the birthplace of Jesus, signifying the arrival of the Messiah. The name Marillin carries the meaning “Mary's shining star” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
